parsed.internal_thinking: My attempt to trade with Bob failed because he lacks Ore. I have 4 Wood, 2 Wheat, 1 Brick, and 1 Sheep. I cannot buy a Dev Card (need Ore) or build a settlement (need Brick). I could build a road, but it's better to try and trade for Ore with Alice, who is on the Ore 3 hex (N25). Alice has 2 Wood, 1 Wheat, and 4 Sheep. She might want my Wood to build a road or settlement. I'll offer Wood for her Ore, even though my previous trade attempt with Bob failed, Alice might have different resources. Wait, Alice's resource list shows W:2, Wh:1, S:4. She has NO Ore. Looking at the board, no one has Ore in their inventory. I will trade with the bank for Ore using my Wood (4:1) since I don't have a port yet, then buy a Dev Card to try and get that 3rd Knight.
parsed.note_to_self: Traded 4 wood for 1 ore to try and buy a dev card for the win. Alice and Bob currently have no ore in hand.
parsed.say_outloud: Since nobody seems to have any ore to spare, I'll just have to go to the source. Alice, Bob, don't relax just yet—I'm still hunting for that third knight.
